items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: You remember Pete Brown? ... Pete Brown was an individualist, too. ... And he used to play in the Village quite a bit, too ... But Pete Brown was a fixture.

ctx.x: -- about different guys. I'd just like to mention a couple of things. We mentioned -- We didn't mention in the saxophone section, we were talking -- we sort of skipped guys like Pete Brown. You remember Pete Brown? What a swinging person.
Pete Brown was an individualist, too.
